messages:
Iris: quick flag  morning regen caused a changelog minor bump and broke SDK parity tests in the Go and TS clients.
Iris: small excerpt from regen diff: 
```
- CHANGELOG: 3.4.1 -> 3.5.0
- typegen: reordered optional query params in ListItems(ctx, limit, filter?) -> ListItems(ctx, filter?, limit)
+ docs: added example for batch streams
```
Noel: that reorder looks type-only but apparently the Go helper relied on positional args at runtime.
Sam: running `yarn regen && yarn test:packages/sdk-go --filter parity` fails with panic: wrong number of arguments in helper call.
Tara: immediate plan: 1) revert runtime param swap in helper generator (patch), 2) force-publish patch for Go/TS clients to unblock release pipeline.
Noel: follow-up: regen should distinguish "type-only reordering" vs "runtime wrapper change" and never auto-minor for type-only. add a pre-publish smoke that imports the published package and runs a tiny sampleapp call.
regen-bot: Created task DEVEX-2533: "regen: classify diffs and block auto-minors for type-only changes" (linked PR 4802).
ci-bot: publish job rerun requested for build #5032 (queued).
Sam: adding a unit test to catch overload-guard regressions in auth/retry helpers. will include it in the revert PR.
Iris: assigning revert + patch publish to @Sam. tagging @eng-ml for long-term typegen heuristic review.
Tara: agreed. also we should add a one-release compatibility shim in helpers: accept both arg orders and log deprecation to soften churn.
Iris: thanks all 44D keeping updates here.
